relations.definition: Shares relevant relational structure without asserting identity.
Produces or changes an outcome under declared causal conditions.
Makes a distinction, scope, representation, or mechanism more explicit.
Cannot jointly hold with the target under the same declared interpretation.
Supplies an admissible case that defeats a universal or necessary claim.
Makes the target possible without claiming it is sufficient or inevitable.
Supplies the basis, rule, observation, or invariant on which the target depends.
Operationally realizes a declared abstraction, rule, or interface.
Reduces or constrains the target without necessarily eliminating it.
Produces an observation or quantity about the target under a declared procedure.
Is a declared component or member of the target structure.
Raises or specifies an expected outcome without asserting that the outcome occurred.
Must be available or satisfied before the target can validly proceed.
Blocks the target under the declared conditions.
Restricts the strength, scope, interpretation, or conditions of the target.
Provides defeasible evidence, structure, or capacity in favor of the target.
Maps or changes the source representation or state into the target.
Weakens the warrant or connection supporting the target without directly negating it.
